Source: R/quant-post.R
new_mpaqt_quant_result_enhanced.Rd

Create Enhanced mpaqt_quant_result Object

new_mpaqt_quant_result_enhanced(
  abundances,
  tpm,
  log_likelihood,
  converged,
  iterations,
  fitted_values,
  prior_variance,
  positional_weights = NULL,
  positional_bias_type = NULL,
  lr_coverage_probs = NULL,
  lr_model = NULL,
  prior_predictions = NULL,
  normalization = "tpm",
  normalized_counts = NULL,
  uncertainty = NULL,
  parameters = list(),
  sr_input = list(),
  lr_input = NULL
)

Transcript abundances

TPM values

Prior predictions

normalization

normalized_counts

Normalized counts

uncertainty

Uncertainty estimates

parameters

Algorithm parameters

Short-read input metadata

lr_input

Long-read input metadata

Value

Enhanced mpaqt_quant_result object
